message.title: Welcome!
message.body: Thank you for visiting my test world! This world is in its early design phase. For an example of what the final product might look like, check out City of Glass 2. Changelog: • Added new tutorial area • Added new building on the flattest roof • Sun now follows proper Altitude/Azimuth • Added footstep sounds for metal
